description: Flat metadata schema for individual fecal microbiome sequencing samples collected from mammalian hosts (rodents, primates, domestic animals) to study host and environmental influences on gut microbiome composition and function.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample/record. Must be stable and non-duplicated within the dataset.

host_species.descr: Host species name in binomial form, e.g., Homo sapiens, Mus musculus, Canis lupus familiaris.

host_common_name.descr: Common name of the host species, e.g., human, house mouse, dog.

host_taxon_class.descr: Mammalian class or higher-level taxonomic grouping, e.g., Rodentia, Primates, Carnivora, Artiodactyla.

host_age.descr: Host age at sampling. Prefer numeric value in years; if exact age is unknown, use estimated age in years or months and document the estimate method separately if needed.

host_age_unit.descr: Unit for host age, e.g., years, months, days.

host_life_stage.descr: Life stage at sampling, e.g., neonate, juvenile, subadult, adult, aged.

host_sex.descr: Biological sex of the host, e.g., female, male, unknown.

host_health_status.descr: Health status at sampling, e.g., healthy, diseased, asymptomatic, recovering, unknown.

host_clinical_condition.descr: Specific diagnosis or condition if applicable, e.g., obesity, inflammatory bowel disease, diarrhea, antibiotic-associated dysbiosis.

host_body_mass.descr: Host body mass at sampling, in kilograms (kg).

host_body_mass_unit.descr: Unit for body mass, typically kg.

host_diet_type.descr: Primary diet category, e.g., herbivore, carnivore, omnivore, insectivore, specialized feeder.

host_diet_detail.descr: More detailed diet description, e.g., grass-fed, grain-based feed, mixed household diet, wild foraged fruits and leaves.

host_captivity_status.descr: Living condition of the host at sampling, e.g., wild, captive, farmed, zoo, laboratory, household/pet.

host_housing_type.descr: Housing environment, e.g., outdoor enclosure, indoor kennel, barn, laboratory cage, free-ranging.

sampling_date.descr: Date of fecal sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_time.descr: Time of sample collection if available, preferably in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS).

sample_type.descr: Biological material collected, expected to be fecal/stool for this study.

sample_freshness.descr: Whether the fecal sample was collected fresh or from the environment; e.g., fresh, environmental droppings, unknown.

sample_collection_method.descr: How the sample was collected, e.g., direct rectal/fecal collection, noninvasive field collection, swabbed feces.

sample_storage_temp_c.descr: Storage temperature after collection, in degrees Celsius (°C), e.g., -80, -20, 4.

sample_storage_duration_h.descr: Time between collection and stabilization or long-term storage, in hours.

sample_preservation_method.descr: Preservation method used, e.g., immediate freezing, RNAlater, ethanol, silica desiccation, no preservative.

sampling_location_country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

sampling_location_region.descr: Administrative region/state/province where collected, if available.

sampling_location_locality.descr: Locality description such as city, village, reserve, farm, park, or site name.

sampling_altitude_m.descr: Sampling altitude/elevation in meters above sea level (m).

environment_type.descr: Environmental context of the host habitat, e.g., urban, rural, forest, grassland, farm, captive facility.

climate_zone.descr: General climatic zone at the sampling location, e.g., tropical, temperate, arid, boreal.

season.descr: Season during sampling, e.g., spring, summer, autumn/fall, winter, wet season, dry season.

host_group.descr: Broad mammalian grouping for cross-species analysis, e.g., rodent, primate, domestic animal.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, Oxford Nanopore.

library_strategy.descr: Library preparation or sequencing strategy, e.g., shotgun metagenomic sequencing, 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction protocol or kit used, including kit name when available.

insert_size_bp.descr: Average library insert size in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

host_antibiotic_exposure.descr: Whether the host received antibiotics within a relevant pre-sampling window; use true/false/unknown if unknown is encoded separately.

host_probiotic_use.descr: Whether the host was receiving probiotics or microbiome-targeted supplements at sampling.

host_medication_use.descr: Whether the host was using non-antibiotic medications that may affect the microbiome at sampling.

recent_disease_treatment.descr: Whether the host underwent recent treatment for disease before sampling, e.g., antibiotics, antiparasitics, surgery.

notes.descr: Free-text field for additional sample-specific information, deviations from protocol, or ambiguous metadata.
